title: Imp Jar Triple Berry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Triple Berry from Imp Jar brings together the irresistible flavours of three different Berries with a cool menthol hit, including Strawberry, Raspberry and Blackberry, creating a berrylicious symphony for your taste buds. This sweet, slightly tart blend offers a burst of vibrant fruitiness that is truly unforgettable, and utterly moreish. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices and is available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strength. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. Nicotine Salt e-liquids are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. Imp Jar e-liquids replicate a wide array of delicious flavours made popular across numerous disposable vape devices, ranging from fruity delights, icy chills, sugary candies, to refreshing beverages. Offering 50ml of 0mg e-liquid in their shortfill range, Imp Jar allows for the addition of an 18mg nic shot to craft 60ml of nicotine-infused e-liquid. Imp Jar's Salts range also harnesses the power of nicotine salts, ensuring a gentle yet satisfying throat hit and fast relief from nicotine cravings.
